title: THE SWITCHBACK · HILL LAPS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · upper stations, uphill legs, 24-min clock
why: Legs sprinted flat yesterday and squatted Monday, so today the run leg goes UPHILL and every station is upper body. Same gauntlet arc, new clock: as many stations as you can clear in 24 minutes.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders + spine

items.name: Jefferson curl 35 lb ×6, slow · wrist rocks 30s
Belt 3.5 mph @ 8% · 2 min
items.detail: set the grade now, it stays all session

blocks.title: THE SWITCHBACK · 24 MIN · AMRAP
blocks.meta: 24 MIN CAP · 5 STATIONS PER LAP · TARGET 10 STATIONS (2 LAPS) · STRETCH 12 · 40 lb · 50 lb · 2×40 lb
blocks.format: 24-MIN CLOCK · station, then HILL LEG, next station · count stations cleared
blocks.workRest: Every station exits onto the belt: RUN 0.10 mi @ 6.0 / 8%. Belt stays at 6.0 / 8% the whole 24 min.

items.name: S1 · Z press 40 lb ×8/side → HILL LEG
S2 · Split-stance row 50 lb ×10/side, 2-count hold at the top → HILL LEG
S3 · One-arm floor press 40 lb ×12/side → HILL LEG
S5 · Push-up ×15, hands on the 40 lb bells → HILL LEG
REPEAT S1 → S5 until the clock hits 24:00

blocks.noteGreen: Log stations cleared at 24:00 and the station where the hill leg started to win.
blocks.text: ★ Z PRESS — sit on the floor, legs straight and wide, press from the rack with nothing behind you. ★ SPLIT-STANCE ROW — one foot forward, bell on the rear-leg side, row to the hip and hold. ★ BODY SAW — on the forearms, feet in socks on the hard floor, push the whole body back with the elbows, pull it back in. ★ HILL LEG — short steps, quick feet, hands off the rails.

items.name: Half-kneeling chop 35 lb ×8/side
items.detail: high to low, across the body
